verticalDatum: Copernicus GLO-30 EGM2008 orthometric surface elevations, relative to inland approach in the viewer.

contact.basis: Unaltered provider elevation on the inland approach just outside the raised hotel entrance.

attribution: Contains modified Copernicus DEM data. European Space Agency and Airbus Defence and Space GmbH.
method: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 source pixels from a geographic crop, bilinearly sampled in the model frame. No geometric cut, replacement or added flattening.
limitations: GLO-30 is a roughly 30 m digital surface model and retains some roof/vegetation peaks in the urban cells. Surface water levels follow the native provider.
